purpose: Read-only five-domain capture of the first 3600 airborne Mission 01 player updates.

clock.cadence_mapping: zero-order hold each oracle input for two native ticks and compare every second native snapshot
clock.runtime_correction: disabled: the existing 60 Hz presentation hook crashes the executed flight cone at guest address 0x7E980000
clock.arm: owned file created after the qualified flight HUD capture and an explicit 0x822A6710 readiness event

boundaries.role: one event group after each airborne player update

controller_normalization.yaw: left shoulder=-32768, right shoulder=32767, otherwise thumb_rx
controller_normalization.qualification: route-harness mapping only; it assigns no semantic name to the guest input aggregate fields

limitations: player and child transform words are raw qualified guest fields, not native semantic names
the empty objective list states that no executed objective registry boundary is qualified yet
graphics records describe submissions even when the retail world output is black
